stories.title: Define relevance scoring schema and contract
stories.description: Create Pydantic response schema for clinical trial condition relevance scoring, including inputs (user condition intent, trial conditions) and outputs (normalized relevance score, contributing factors, confidence). Align with existing clinical_trials_models structures.

stories.title: Implement condition relevance scoring logic
stories.description: Develop backend logic to compute similarity between user condition intent and trial conditions using structured matching (exact, partial, synonym) and/or embedding-based similarity. Output normalized score and explanation factors.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_models/clinical_trials_models.py (structured condition inputs enable matching logic); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/embeddings/embedding_client.py (available similarity capability)

stories.title: Integrate relevance scoring into clinical trials service
stories.description: Integrate relevance scoring into clinical_trials_service so each returned trial includes a relevance score based on user query conditions. Ensure compatibility with existing trial search and filtering flow.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/clinical_trials_service.py (trial retrieval pipeline for enrichment with scores)

stories.title: Expose relevance scores via Evaluate Care facade
stories.description: Update evaluate_care_facade to include relevance score in clinical trial responses returned to the chat layer, ensuring consistent API contract for downstream consumption.

stories.title: Unit and integration tests for relevance scoring
stories.description: Create tests validating scoring correctness (exact vs partial matches), edge cases (no condition match), and integration within clinical trials service responses.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/ (existing test patterns for services and infrastructure)
